audit.whatIsWrong: Every one of the seven level-chart stages was awarded to Volibear and the lane was rated EVEN 6/10, against a 56.59% Cho'Gath win rate over 311 games - and against the page's own prose, which says the lane flips at 4-5 and that 6 is 'a clean kill for you'.
audit.why: The chart contradicts both the win rate and the surrounding text. Volibear's edge is the level 2-3 brawl only.
audit.corrected: FAV, 6.5/10; chart Skill / Volibear / Volibear / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath with ratings 5,4,4,6,7,7,7.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes were described as 'his W heal' and 'tank components' with no ability names and no cooldowns - the packet flags this matchup as never naming a single Volibear ability.
audit.why: His curve is defined by Frenzied Maul on a flat 5s, Thundering Smash on 12 to 10s, Sky Splitter on a flat 16s and Stormbringer on 160/135/110s.
audit.corrected: Levels 2-3 are his on the 5s Frenzied Maul heal; 4-5 onward are yours; 6 is Feast's true damage against his Stormbringer dive.
sources: tools/audit-run/packets/chogath.json (defect: never names any of Volibear's abilities)

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says four times that Feral Scream 'silences his R shield'. Stormbringer (R) has no shield - it is a leap that grants bonus health and disables nearby towers. The shield belongs to Sky Splitter (E). The page also calls Thundering Smash a dash.
audit.why: Riot's text: Sky Splitter 'grants Volibear a Shield if he's inside the blast radius'; Stormbringer 'leaps to a target location... Enemy towers near his landing location become temporarily disabled'. Thundering Smash is 'gains speed towards enemies' - a charge, not a dash, and it is flagged as an auto-attack reset.
audit.corrected: Feral Scream denies the Sky Splitter shield (16s) and the Stormbringer cast; Rupture's knockup ends the Thundering Smash approach before the stun lands; Stormbringer disables your tower, so it is no refuge.
sources: champ-data/_kits/volibear.json (E shield, R dash + tower disable, Q autoReset/hardCC)

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was named as a do but never tied to the ability or to on-hit scaling.
audit.why: Frenzied Maul carries both heal and onHit flags: the second cast on the same target heals him and it applies item on-hit effects, so his damage scales with attack speed from The Relentless Storm rather than with raw AD. Armour alone reads the trade wrong.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds against Frenzied Maul's 5-second heal, and expect on-hit rather than pure physical burst.
sources: champ-data/_kits/volibear.json (W heal + onHit, P attack speed)

audit.whatIsWrong: Stormbringer's tower disable was never mentioned.
audit.why: It removes the one thing a losing Cho'Gath relies on, so 'run to tower' is wrong advice while his ultimate is up.
audit.corrected: Named it in the don'ts alongside the 160/135/110s cooldown.

Frenzied Maul heals him on every second cast into the same target on a flat 5-second cooldown, and Thundering Smash stuns the first enemy he attacks once he has built up speed, so he out-brawls me before my Rupture-into-Feral-Scream is online. edits.before: Once I hit 4-5 the lane flips: Carnivore sustain, Vorpal Spikes waveclear, and my Rupture-Scream combo stabilize me and start out-lasting his W heal. At 6 Feast is the difference — it's point-blank true damage that ignores armor, MR, and his stack-heal, so when he Q-dashes in I can Rupture to knock him up, Feral Scream to silence his R shield, and Feast to execute through everything. Bait the brawl, then punish the dash on cooldown.
edits.after: By 4-5 the lane flips: Carnivore sustain and Vorpal Spikes waveclear out-last a 5-second heal. At 6 Feast is the difference - true damage that ignores armour, MR and the Frenzied Maul heal. The sequence matters. Rupture ends the Thundering Smash charge, Feral Scream denies Sky Splitter, which only shields him if he stands inside his own blast, and then Feast executes. Punish the charge on its cooldown and never let him get a running start at you.

edits.before: I own the extended fight from first item on. In fights my Rupture knockup interrupts his Q dash engage and Feral Scream silences his R shield, and Feast deletes him through bruiser HP — he scales and dives, but I scale harder and answer the dive with a true-damage execute he can't itemize against.
edits.after: I own the extended fight from first item on. Feast stacks plus health items make me the tankier brawler, and a 5-second Frenzied Maul heal cannot out-pace that once I have Grievous Wounds. In fights my Rupture knockup ends his Thundering Smash charge and Feral Scream denies the Sky Splitter shield, and Feast deletes him through bruiser HP. notes: The 'R shield' error ran through four separate fields (spikes[3], whys[6], mid, late, wants.you[0]) - the shield is on Sky Splitter (E), not Stormbringer (R) - so treat any other Volibear page with the same phrasing as suspect. Also: chogath.json tags Rupture (Q) with grounding ('shuts off enemy dashes'), which is a tooltip-parse misfire on the words 'Ruptures the ground'; the same false positive appears on Malphite Q and Olaf Q. I asserted only the knockup, which Riot's description does support. Whether Thundering Smash's stun is reduced by tenacity is not in the data, so I did not claim it.
